content_zh:
藏在泥泞中的两人，被震得几乎脱离地面。
一只恐怖的大手从云层探下来，只一抓，就将整个死人坑连同那头小山似的妖兽抓在手里。
大手慢慢的缩回去，回到云层之上。
沉闷的咀嚼声，像低低的闷雷一般响起。
天色一暗，冰冷的黑血瓢泼而下，一阵接一阵，把军营前的空地淋成死黑色，散发出让人作呕的腥臭气息。
好一阵之后，云层中的咀嚼声停下来，下雨般的黑血也渐渐消失。
两只大脚迈开步子，轰隆轰隆朝远方走去，只几步的功夫，就走出了顾青山和赵六的视线。
赵六失神的道：“那是什么怪物……”
顾青山一颗心沉到谷底，喃喃道：“竟然连它都出现了……”
赵六重复着呓语：“那是什么怪物……那是什么怪物……”
顾青山顾不上他，只在心中暗暗思索。
无面巨人，极其罕见的妖魔，混沌种的强大存在。
无面巨人轻易不会出现，只有在妖魔包围人族阵地久攻不下之时，才会接受号令，前来攻击人族阵地。
按照前世的记忆，现在是承平末年，第一次妖魔之乱才刚刚开始，怎么会出现无面巨人这样怪物？
无面巨人第一次出现，是在玩家进入游戏之后的头一年。
那时人族和妖魔之间爆发大战，战争打了整整一年才结束，顾青山对此记得很清楚。
在这一年的最后决战中，千百万玩家都拿无面巨人没有办法，愣是让无面巨人攻破了边城。
当时玩家们进入游戏不过短短一年光景，级别和修为都很一般，无面巨人的出现，给所有玩家带来了深深的无力感。
最后还是三圣之一的玄元天尊亲自出手，才击杀了此魔。
但是那时候，边城已破，人族兵败如山倒，不得不从地图上往后退缩，让出了大片丰饶土地作为缓冲。

第一次战役，人族就此败退。
但是！但是！
现在是承平末年啊，战争才刚刚开始，人族和妖魔还在彼此试探中。
这个时候，无面巨人就出现了，实在是和剧情对不上。
除非是有什么顾青山也不知道的事情发生了。
顾青山只觉得心中有一团迷雾，怎么也拨不开，看不到其中的真相。
赵六目光呆滞，依旧在不停的重复说着同一句话。
“那是什么怪物……”
啪的一声，顾青山在赵六后颈拍击一下，让他陷入昏迷之中。
赵六受到的刺激太剧烈，神志都快出问题了，还是休息一下好。
第一次见到无面巨人这样的怪物，就连不少玩家都深深为之震撼，更别说这是一个真实的世界，赵六是个普通人，骤然撞见此魔，吓的疯掉也是可能。
顾青山将赵六拎进营房，丢在一张行军榻上，又转身来到军营门口。
无面巨人既然出现，说不定，还有配合它的兵种。
等了不到一刻钟，魔军出现了。
头生独角的幽火邪蛇在丛林中穿梭，蜿蜒向前的身子无声无息划过地面，留下一道烈焰焚烧的痕迹。
在它的背上，坐着一个类人的怪物，身穿灰色重铠，手脚皆爪，脸上没有其他五官，只有一张血淋淋的大口，往后裂开直到后脑。
疯狂嗜杀的饮血魔。
若让它突入到人族部队中，能造成一场小型屠杀。
随着第一头幽火邪蛇出现，更多的幽火邪蛇接踵而至，每一头邪蛇的背上，都坐着饮血魔。
一、二、三……一共二十头。

顾青山屏住呼吸，站在军营中默默的数着。
魔军很快从军营前掠过，追着无面巨人的方向，消失在丛林里。
整个过程中，军营都没有被发现，实在是值得庆幸的事。
但顾青山怎么也高兴不起来。
幽火邪蛇是妖兽中的暗杀之王，行动无声，且天生就开化了五行之火，极其难对付。
更不要说驾驭它的饮血魔有多么恐怖。
这一座军营的守营将军，就是死在数头饮血魔的手中。
在军队中，有一个不成文的规定，士兵们在完成任务的过程中，如果遇上了饮血魔，可以立刻放弃任务，而不会被上峰责罚。
只有将军们才有可能对抗这种魔头。
二十头幽火邪蛇，二十名饮血魔，几乎可以发起一场突袭战。
它们跟随着无面巨人的步伐，悄然而去。
这是要出大事啊。
顾青山正想着，忽然看见一只小巧的飞鸟停在军营外的树枝上。

content_en:
The two people hiding in the mud were shaken almost off the ground.
A terrifying big hand reached down from the clouds, and with just one grab, it grabbed the entire death pit and the hill-like monster in its hand.
The big hand slowly retracted and returned to the clouds.
The dull sound of chewing sounded like low muffled thunder.
As soon as the sky darkened, cold black blood poured down, one after another, turning the open space in front of the military camp into a deadly black color, exuding a disgusting stench.
After a while, the chewing sounds in the clouds stopped, and the rain of black blood gradually disappeared.
Two big feet stepped forward, booming and walking towards the distance. In just a few steps, they were out of the sight of Gu Qingshan and Zhao Liu.
Zhao Liu said in confusion: "What kind of monster is that..."
Gu Qingshan's heart sank to the bottom of the valley, and he murmured: "It even appeared..."
Zhao Liu repeated his murmur: "What kind of monster is that... What kind of monster is that..."
Gu Qingshan couldn't care about him and just thought about it secretly in his heart.
A faceless giant, an extremely rare demon, a powerful existence of the species of chaos.
The faceless giant will not appear easily. Only when the demons have surrounded the human position for a long time and cannot attack it, will they accept the order and come to attack the human position.
According to the memory of the previous life, it is now the end of peace, and the first demonic rebellion has just begun. How could a monster like the faceless giant appear?
The faceless giant first appears in the first year after players enter the game.
At that time, a war broke out between humans and demons. The war lasted for a whole year before it ended. Gu Qingshan remembered this very clearly.
In the final battle of the year, millions of players had no choice but to let the Faceless Giant attack the border town.
At that time, the players had only been in the game for a year, and their levels and cultivation were average. The appearance of the faceless giant gave all players a deep sense of powerlessness.
In the end, it was Xuanyuan Tianzun, one of the Three Saints, who personally took action to kill the demon.
But at that time, the border city had been destroyed, and the human race was defeated like a mountain. They had to retreat from the map and give up a large area of ​​fertile land as a buffer.
In the first battle, the human race was defeated.
but! but!
It is now the end of the Peace, the war has just begun, and humans and demons are still testing each other.
At this time, the faceless giant appeared, which really didn't fit in with the plot.
Unless something happened that Gu Qingshan didn't know about.
Gu Qingshan only felt that there was a fog in his heart, and he couldn't get rid of it and couldn't see the truth.
Zhao Liu's eyes were dull and he kept repeating the same sentence.
"What kind of monster is that..."
With a snap, Gu Qingshan slapped Zhao Liu on the back of his neck, causing him to fall into coma.
The stimulation that Zhao Liu received was so intense that he almost lost his mind. It was better to take a rest.
Even many players were deeply shocked when they saw a monster like the Faceless Giant for the first time, not to mention that this was a real world. Zhao Liu was an ordinary person, and it was possible for him to go crazy when he suddenly bumped into this monster.
Gu Qingshan carried Zhao Liu into the barracks, threw him on a military couch, and then turned around and came to the entrance of the barracks.
Now that the faceless giant has appeared, maybe there are troops to match it.
After waiting for less than a quarter of an hour, the demon army appeared.
The evil fire snake with its first single horn shuttled through the jungle, its body snaking forward silently across the ground, leaving a trail of burning flames.
On its back sat a humanoid monster, wearing heavy gray armor, with claws on its hands and feet. There were no other facial features on its face, only a bloody mouth that split open to the back of its head.
Crazy blood-drinking demon.
If it were allowed to break into the human army, it could cause a small massacre.
As the first evil fire snake appeared, more evil fire snakes followed, and on the back of each evil snake sat a blood-drinking demon.
One, two, three... twenty in total.
Gu QingshanpingHold your breath and stand in the military camp silently counting.
The demon army quickly passed by the military camp, chasing the direction of the faceless giant, and disappeared into the jungle.
During the whole process, the military camp was not discovered, which is really something to be thankful for.
But Gu Qingshan couldn't be happy.
The Ghost Fire Evil Snake is the king of assassinations among monster beasts. It moves silently and is born with the fire of the five elements. It is extremely difficult to deal with.
Not to mention how terrifying the blood-drinking demon that controls it is.
The general guarding this military camp died at the hands of several blood-drinking demons.
In the army, there is an unwritten rule. If soldiers encounter a blood-drinking demon while completing a mission, they can abandon the mission immediately without being punished by the superior.
Only generals can possibly fight against this demon.
Twenty evil fire snakes and twenty blood-drinking demons can almost launch a surprise battle.
They followed the steps of the faceless giant and left quietly.
Something big is going to happen.
Gu Qingshan was thinking when he suddenly saw a small flying bird sitting on a branch outside the military camp.
